JSSC Field Worker JFWCE 2024 Exam Date 2026 (510 Post) | Out @ JFWCE 2024 - Complete Details

Jharkhand Staff Selection Commission (JSSC) has Officially Released Exam Date for the Post of Jharkhand Kshetriya Karyakarta (Field Worker) Competitive Examination (JFWCE-2024) Recruitment 2024. Exam Held On July 5, 2026 & Admit Card Released On June, 2026. All Eligible & Interested Candidates Can Read Full notification Before Apply Online Now in the Given Link Below..

Important Dates

  • Online Apply Start:On:  01 August 2024
  • Last Date for Registration: 31 August 2024 (11:59 PM)
  • Fee Payment Last Date :  07 September 2024
  • Last Date for Photo & Sig Upload: 09 September 2024

  • Admit Card Available :  June 2026
  • Exam Date :  05 July 2026

Application Fee
